title: First Amendment to Incremental Electric Service Agreement between Commonwealth Electric Company and Cape Cod Ice Company.
filings: APPROVAL by the Commission of the First Amendment to Incremental Electric Service Agreement between Commonwealth Electric Company and Cape Cod Ice Company. Participating were: John B. Howe, Chairman; and Janet Gail Besser, Commissioner.
Letter in compliance with the letter order of the Department dated 11.29.96. By: John Cope-Flanagan, Regulatory Attorney, Commonwealth Electric Company.
